reviewer_approval.approval_statement: The project owner reviewed Market System Development - Status and Pre-Research Review v4, confirmed the objective, completed-work summary, free-source-only policy, R.9F description and sampled-identity limitation, added a constrained alternative-source policy, and authorized only a later task to prepare an interlock-removal proposal. The interlock must not be changed in that proposal task. Database connection, SQL, PRAGMAs, schema inspection, audit execution, market-row access, acquisition, market analysis, scoring, simulation, backtesting, recommendations, broker actions and trading remain prohibited.

reviewer_questions.answer: If current data sources fail, are unavailable, inaccessible, or do not meet required data-quality standards, suggest lawful free alternative sources. For example, if the existing F&O database fails qualification, evaluate official NSE F&O bhavcopies for all history that is lawfully available and accessible.

alternative_source_policy.trigger: A current source is unavailable, inaccessible through ordinary permitted access, or fails declared data-quality acceptance gates.
alternative_source_policy.required_response: Identify and compare lawful free alternatives against the same provenance, completeness, point-in-time, identity, correction, retention and reproducibility requirements.
alternative_source_policy.example_candidate: Official NSE F&O bhavcopies for the lawfully available historical interval if the bound local F&O database fails qualification.
constraints: Do not bypass CAPTCHA, authentication, access controls, robots restrictions, rate limits or licensing restrictions.
Do not treat technical availability as permission, completeness or research fitness.
Do not describe a bhavcopy as a complete historical security population without separate evidence.
Preserve raw evidence immutably only when retention is permitted.
Apply the existing provider-neutral ingestion and dataset trust gates.
Obtain any separate approval required before acquisition or use.

statement: PDF v4 was explicitly reviewed after generation. The next task may prepare only a code-reviewable interlock-removal proposal. It may not implement or remove the interlock, access the database, execute an audit, acquire alternative data, analyze markets, score, simulate, backtest, recommend, access a broker or trade.
